blocks.text: Sulphuric acid contact process se banaya jata hai. Contact process ka flow sheet (step by step naqsha) Figure 12.12 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Contact plant ka flow sheet, left se right: Sulphur burner (Air, Sulphur andar); Impure SO2+O2 Dust precipitator se; Washing and cooling tower (Water spray, Waste water); Drying tower (Conc. H2SO4 spray, Waste acid); Dry SO2+O2 Arsenic purifier, Testing box aur Preheater se; Catalytic converter (V2O5); SO3 Quartz aur Conc. H2SO4 spray wale tower mein; Oleum (H2S2O7) bahar.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.12: Sulphuric acid ki industrial preparation (tayyari) ka contact process (kitab ki Figure 12.12 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diagram ko left se right parhein: pehle sulfur jal kar SO2 banti hai, phir gas saaf ki jati hai (dhool, pani aur arsenic hataye jate hain) kyunke yeh catalyst ko kharab karte hain. Testing box mein dekha jata hai ke gas saaf hai. Preheater gas ko 420-450 °C tak garam karta hai, converter mein V₂O₅ par SO2 se SO3 banti hai, aur aakhri tower mein SO3 concentrated (gaarha) H₂SO₄ mein absorb (jazb) ho kar oleum banati hai.
Contact process ko in stages (marhalon) mein divide kiya ja sakta hai:
Sulfur/pyrite Burners
Process pighle hue (molten) sulfur ko jala kar, ya pyrite (jaise iron pyrite, FeS₂) ko zyada hawa mein garam kar ke shuru hota hai; is se sulfur dioxide (SO₂) banti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne iron pyrite ka formula FeS likha hai aur equation 4FeS + 6O₂ → 2Fe₂O₃ + 4SO₂ di hai, jo balanced nahi (left side 12 O, right side 14 O). Iron pyrite FeS₂ hai: 4FeS₂ + 11O₂ → 2Fe₂O₃ + 8SO₂. (Agar FeS hi lein to sahi equation 4FeS + 7O₂ → 2Fe₂O₃ + 4SO₂ hai.)
Purification Unit (safai ka hissa)

Agar sulfur ke liye pyrite ore istemal ho to SO₂ gas mein dhool ke particles (zarra), vapours (bhaap) aur arsenic oxide jaisi impurities (milawat) ho sakti hain. Yeh impurities catalyst ki efficiency (kaarkardagi) kharab karti hain, is liye gas ko purification unit se guzara jata hai. Arsenic purifier mein horizontal (ufqi) shelves par jelly jaisa ferric hydroxide, Fe(OH)₃, arsenic oxide (As₂O₃) ko absorb kar leta hai.
Contact Tower and Heat Exchangers

Saaf SO₂ aur hawa ko 420–450 °C tak pehle se garam (preheat) kar ke 1–2 atm pressure par contact tower ke pehle converter stage mein bheja jata hai. Yahan yeh gases vanadium pentoxide (V₂O₅) catalyst se milti hain.
Catalyst do steps (qadam) mein kaam karta hai:
V⁵⁺ SO₂ ko SO₃ mein oxidise karta hai (aur khud V⁴⁺ ban jata hai):

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein product '4V₂O₄' likha hai, jo balanced nahi (left side 2 V atoms, right side 8). Ek V₂O₅ se ek V₂O₄ banta hai: SO₂ + V₂O₅ → SO₃ + V₂O₄.
Phir oxygen V⁴⁺ ko wapas V⁵⁺ bana deti hai (catalyst dobara taiyar, regeneration):
Quick Check 12.6

blocks.prompt: a) SO₃ banane ke liye zyada temperature aur catalyst kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: SO₂ ki oxidation exothermic hai lekin kam temperature par bohat sust (slow) hai. Catalyst activation energy kam karta hai; 420–450 °C ka darmiyana temperature reaction ko tez bhi karta hai aur equilibrium mein SO₃ ki achhi amount (miqdar) bhi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Concentrated H₂SO₄ ke starch aur oxalic acid ke saath dehydration reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation: Starch: (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ → 6nC + 5nH₂O (conc. H₂SO₄ pani nikal leta hai aur carbon bach jata hai). Oxalic acid: H₂C₂O₄ → CO + CO₂ + H₂O (conc. H₂SO₄ ke saath).

blocks.prompt: c) SO₂ ko SO₃ mein badalne mein V₂O₅ catalyst kaise kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle V₂O₅ (V⁵⁺) SO₂ ko SO₃ mein oxidise karta hai aur khud V₂O₄ (V⁴⁺) ban jata hai: SO₂ + V₂O₅ → SO₃ + V₂O₄. Phir oxygen V₂O₄ ko wapas V₂O₅ bana deti hai: V₂O₄ + ½O₂ → V₂O₅. Is tarah catalyst kharch nahi hota.

blocks.text: Absorption Tower
Sulfur trioxide ko thanda kiya jata hai; pani se react kar ke yeh sulphuric acid ban sakta hai:

Lekin SO₃ ko seedha pani mein milana mumkin nahi, kyun ke reaction bohat zyada garmi (extremely exothermic) deta hai aur liquid solution ke bajaye acid ki dhund (mist) ban jati hai. Is liye SO₃ ko ghoomte hue (recirculating) garam 98.5% sulphuric acid mein hal kiya jata hai. SO₃ aur 100% sulphuric acid ke mixture ko fuming sulphuric acid ya oleum kehte hain.
Oleum pani se react kar ke H₂SO₄ ka bohat concentrated solution banata hai, jis ki concentration zaroorat ke hisaab se rakhi ja sakti hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Burners: S ya pyrite jala kar SO₂ (∆H = -297.03 kJ/mol).
Purification: Fe(OH)₃ arsenic oxide hatata hai, warna catalyst kharab hota hai.
Contact tower: 420–450 °C, 1–2 atm, V₂O₅ par SO₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ SO₃.
Absorption: SO₃ 98.5% H₂SO₄ mein → oleum (H₂S₂O₇); pani mila kar H₂SO₄.
